bounded_correction.regression: For both provider identities, use valid synthetic signal artifacts then mutate event_id to 16 hex, a typed string to null, and a world_changes array to one row. The existing schema validator must reject each applicable new snapshot; the shared publication gate and supervisor must reject before any ledger/checkpoint/board write, snapshot seal, Git operation, or paid automatic retry. Valid new/terminal-stop samples pass. Immutable old bytes are preserved and are not regraded into rewritten history.
bounded_correction.interface_caution: The direct committer --check interface currently receives only a record file and assumes research validation; manifest schema routing needs the original publication path explicitly retained rather than inferred from a temporary filename.
bounded_correction.owner: Shared cockpit publication boundary owns implementation; screening signal-gate and thesis/candidate synthesizers own producer conformance. Hand off this concrete shared correction rather than creating a second admission path.

qualifiers: A board projection of a historical invalid record proves local projection admission, not a new live-production incident or an erroneous investment outcome.
The one-world-change historical record is watchlist_no_source already. Its structural nonconformance is not evidence that the world-change business gate promoted it.
Optional null strings are structural defects, not automatically material evidence or economic-mechanism failures.

Schema validity never establishes source authenticity, original full-content availability, point-in-time knowledge, independence, or investment skill. A separate provenance/authenticity cohort gate must quarantine fixtures and synthetic source URLs before prospective-performance admission.

Keep early-stop semantics, immutable records, runtime provenance, provider parity, and bounded recoverable refusal. Do not widen schema patterns to admit historical malformed data or replace missing facts with invented strings.

Disabled/provider/admission/cap holds each have distinguishable code/log paths.
Reviewed service template explicitly enables the conviction flag. Code default-off therefore does not prove the installed service is off. Actual runtime was not inspected.

Dispatcher reuses launch(kind=conviction) with exact thesis/checkpoint IDs and author profile. Run root is screener/ledger/conviction/runs/<checkpoint_id>; writes include calendar, append-only ledger, that thesis state, and board.

Existing validator reads the frozen full falsification sentence over parsed hints; fetches actual approved sources, units, period and dates; returns judgment without writes. A kill requires two independent approved sources; absent value is unresolved.

Deterministic rescorer uses repository mutation lease, immutable observation keys and replay. It parks a one-source breach and discards on a two-source breach. It appends validation_result and conviction_event before projecting state/calendar. Unresolved is still recorded; zero rows is not itself a source-insufficiency diagnosis.

Aggregator consumes only local conviction.ndjson validation_result rows, excludes unresolved, retains null metrics below N=10. Publication invokes deterministic calibration; a refresh failure is a visible warning after safely committed review, not grounds to rerun paid work.

protocol: Coordinator resumes the latest append-only checkpoint, verifies current baseline/candidate SHAs and existing PR delivery, and selects one decision bottleneck. Keep one active experiment; a 45-minute tick need not start new work.

Reuse manifest-discovered existing analytical roles. Assign bounded read-only questions to at most two complementary specialists plus one independent challenger within available concurrency. Each gets frozen inputs, owned output path, allowed sources, budget and a concrete completion criterion. Avoid paid dispatch and production mutation.

Source/meaning work reuses screener-event-statement, screener-world-change, screener-novelty and relevant evidence tools; exposure/ranking work reuses screener-beneficiary-map, screener-market-implied and candidate-surfacing only after its routing prerequisites; outcome work reuses screener-checkpoint-validator and the existing deterministic calibrator/rescorer contracts.

Independent challenge reuses screener-thesis-red-team and integrity rules. It checks source authenticity, qualifier retention, point-in-time availability, numerical basis, counterevidence, likely false positives and missed opportunities; it may cap/reject but never raises conviction or rewrites a locked record.

Coordinator reads each complete report, records every material finding as accepted, rejected with evidence, or blocked, and resolves contradictory facts by source hierarchy rather than majority vote. One implementation owner makes one coherent candidate only after preregistration.

Preregister sample IDs, exact forecast horizons, matching variables, primary metric, acceptance rule, cost budget and critical guardrails before seeing outcome labels. Baseline and candidate use identical frozen inputs, lags, universe, policy and costs; preserve all variants including failed ones.

Immediate correctness fixes use deterministic regressions and admissible positive controls. Historical LLM replays remain development evidence once viewed. Predictive claims need untouched historical out-of-sample or prospective shadow outcomes with all eligible selected/rejected/abstained cases registered.

Admit, reject, or hold in shadow only on the preregistered rule. Preserve small-N refusals and human/spending gates. Deliver accepted code through the protected PR workflow and standing authorized merge path; inspect automatic deployment read-only where relevant. Append evidence, disposition, delivery and one next action.

If two consecutive ticks add no evidence to one obstacle, narrow or change method, or record that dependency blocked and continue independent work. Do not multiply active candidates while waiting for review or outcome labels.

cautions: The existing selected-minus-discarded edge score is explicitly a proxy, not realized investment return.
Eligible rejected, low-ranked and abstained cases must remain in the registered denominator so refusing everything cannot manufacture precision.

Use exact predeclared one-quarter, two-quarter and one-year windows, absolute/market/sector returns, costs, losses, drawdown and concentration. Calibration floors do not prove economic significance or independence.
The feedback-tuning command is recommend-only and prohibits writing live rank weights automatically; preserve that human gate.
